result.reason: The redline appropriately permits Customer assignments to affiliates and transaction successors without consent, requires Customer consent for IBM assignments, and adds no change-of-control termination right. However, it does not prohibit IBM from assigning to a Customer competitor, even with Customer consent, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. It also does not implement the fallback's mutual successor-assignment right upon written notice. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted.
